description: Frozen candidate-selection and improvement-materiality rules. Every threshold here is chosen from operational relevance before any candidate result is visible, and none may be tuned afterwards.

comparisonAuthority.rule: A candidate is compared with the accepted C0 when one exists, otherwise with the diagnostic-only D0. D0 never authorizes publication, materialization, activation or serving.
rejectedForever: the former v12 forecast run fr_b2f18d0e2999a36d
comparisonAuthority.reason: None satisfies the repaired comparison authority: all three predate acceptance-v3/verifier-v4 and feature-schema-v6 cohorting.

usableFor: one read, after the candidate is frozen
confirmationOrigins.rule: Reading a confirmation origin before freezing exactly one candidate invalidates the run.

acceptanceSchedule.rule: A1-A5 still runs over all 13 origins. The confirmation split is an additional gate, not a replacement, so acceptance stays partly in-sample with respect to candidate selection and the materiality gate must be reported on both populations.

candidateRegistry.rule: A family absent from this list may not be scored. Adding one is a pre-result policy amendment.

materiality.rule: Both populations must independently satisfy the improvement and non-regression gates. Reporting only the pooled all-13 result would hide an in-sample-only gain.

pairing.rule: Candidate and authority must score identical eligible rows in identical decision-#82 cohorts. A changed population is a hard failure, not an improvement.

stopRules.trigger: any feature, correction or calibration is not origin-safe
candidate and authority cohort key hashes differ
a supported market fails its gate
a confirmation origin was read before the candidate froze
a pooled gain is contradicted by a majority of slices

forbidden: tuning any threshold in this document after a candidate result is visible
treating a zero actual_sum slice as a pass rather than insufficient_evidence
substituting an aggregate score for SeriesKey accuracy
improving a display value rather than the underlying forecast
insufficientEvidenceRule: A slice whose actual_sum is zero is insufficient_evidence, never a pass.
